machine.cpu: Apple M4 Max, 16 cores (12 performance, 4 efficiency)
machine.other_load: one unrelated process at 100% of one core and a browser renderer at about 70% of one throughout; load average 6 to 10

toolchain.docker: Docker Desktop 29.2.0, VM with 16 vCPUs and 8 GB, kernel 6.12.67-linuxkit

commits.v026: e0d87164cd4fd7dbb0b47270c24a095fb9c4339e (observe-v2), with the bench output added in the commit of this file

method.engine: cargo bench -p iii --bench <name> -- --save-baseline rN --noplot, one target directory per version; rounds interleaved bench by bench (0.25 then 0.26); 2 rounds of every bench, 4 of observe_dispatch, observe_fanout/trigger_fanout, observe_routed and invoke_function_payload_sizes; each bench's own sample size and warm-up
method.figure: criterion's typical time per iteration (slope estimate), mean over rounds; spread = (max - min) / mean over rounds
method.verdict: regression when every 0.26 round is worse than every 0.25 round and the means differ by more than 5%; improvement the other way; otherwise the same within noise
method.rust_sdk: cargo bench -p iii-sdk --bench observe_bench, 3 rounds per version, interleaved; paced pass at 5,000 calls/s for 2 s per case
method.node: pnpm bench (vitest bench --run --config vitest.bench.config.ts), 3 runs, 0.26 only
method.python: the Python SDK has no benchmark
method.loadtest: iii-loadtest suite --profiles host --engine-cpus 4-7 --load-cpus 0-3, in a container limited to CPUs 0-7 and 6 GB; 10 s steps, 2 s warm-up, observability and log level as shipped; runs 0.25, 0.26, 0.25, 0.26

budget.budget: one atomic load, no allocation, 0 frames
budget.measured: `is_observed/false` 0.436 ns; `call_local/no_observers` 1.9 µs a call; at 5,000 calls/s p50 2.04 µs, p99 6.65 µs, 0.000 report items a call. `is_observed_does_not_allocate` and `a_million_unobserved_local_calls_send_no_frame` pass.

budget.scenario: Function matched by keys, observers on other keys (`isObserved(call)` false)
budget.budget: one hash lookup per call key, no allocation
budget.measured: `is_observed_for/key_miss_of_10000` 14.7 ns (one key, 10,000 observers on other keys). `a_key_miss_does_not_allocate` passes.
budget.v025: no equivalent (0.25 has no matching by keys)

budget.scenario: Matching by keys, 1 matching observer among 10,000
budget.budget: ≤ 4 hash lookups + one filter evaluation + 1 report item
budget.measured: `call_local/match_keys_1_of_10000` 3.32 µs a call, against 3.21 µs for a function whose only observer matches; at 5,000 calls/s p50 3.14 µs, 1.000 report items a call. Load test `match-keys`: 897k to 926k calls/s with 100, 1,000 and 10,000 observers. The lookups are not counted: the cost per call does not grow with the observers.
`call_local/10_observers_none_matching` 2.19 µs a call; at 5,000 calls/s mean 2.95 µs, p90 4.04 µs, p99 7.64 µs (a call with no observers has p99 6.65 µs at the same rate).
budget.verdict: within budget (p99 at 5,000 calls/s is above 5 µs, as it is with no observers)

budget.measured: `observe_routed_bench`: one `invokefunction` and one `invocationresult` a call and no other frame, with 0, 1, 8 and 64 observers, over 4,214,226 calls in 4 rounds; `observe_routed/observed/1` 38.5 µs against 34.9 µs unobserved. Node: the answers to `call_routed/1_observer_matching` carry the observer ids (210,571 `invocationresult` frames with `observed` in run 1), and `bench::one-match` has report items for its local calls only (127,590).
budget.v025: the same frames (the engine evaluates); `observe_routed/observed/1` 37.3 µs

budget.scenario: Event source (handler returns its input), observed
budget.measured: `call_local/event_source_observed` 3.64 µs a call; at 5,000 calls/s 1.000 report items a call, 1.000 of them carrying the event once (`output_is_input`, no `output`). Node: every `bench::source` item carries it once.

budget.scenario: Local call to a private function
budget.budget: no copy of input or result when nothing reads the input after the handler; one copy of the input when a hook, a filter or a `capture` reads it
budget.measured: `call_local/private` 1.91 µs (the handler alone: 51.2 ns); `call_local/private_event` 2.21 µs, the same with a deliver hook `call_local/private_deliver_hook` 2.92 µs. `a_local_call_of_a_private_function_copies_nothing` passes (allocations do not grow with the payload).
budget.v025: no equivalent (0.25 has no private functions)

budget.measured: No bench times it. `a_call_through_an_observer_is_the_fixture_frame` passes: the call is one `invokefunction` to the observer's target.
